description: Novo Nordisk is a Danish pharmaceutical company and the originator of the GLP-1 drug category. Its semaglutide franchise — Ozempic (weekly injectable for diabetes), Wegovy (obesity), and Rybelsus (oral diabetes) — drove a multi-year surge that briefly made it the most valuable company in Europe. The company dominates the global obesity drug market alongside Eli Lilly, though it faces pipeline competition from Viking Therapeutics, Structure Therapeutics, and Lilly's retatrutide. Novo also has major insulin and rare disease franchises.
